description: sb-os component manifest. Declarative source of truth for every shippable component the installer renders into a target vault. Edit this file to add, remove, or rename a component; loaders.py reads from here. Components are grouped into modules; users select which modules to install. The 'wiki' module is atomic — selecting it installs all of its components AND creates the wiki folder + wiki CLAUDE.md; deselecting it skips all of them. Component kinds: skills/commands/rules are rewritten on every install (loader and rule-copy semantics). Templates use install-if-missing semantics — they are copied on fresh install, AND on upgrade only when the target file does not exist. Templates are never overwritten so user customizations are preserved across upgrades.
